entries.say.variants.default: That got ugly fast, {addressee.name}. You catch any scratches or bites back there?
entries.reply.debriefed.say.variants.default: Nothing through the jacket, thank God, {addressee.name}. Door's wedged shut—let's catch our breath and check our gear.
entries.reply.cleared.say.variants.default: Looks like the rest of them wandered off down the alley. Keep it quiet for a minute.
entries.reply.shaken.say.variants.default: I'm not bit, just rattled. Give me a second to get my hands steady.
entries.reply.refused.say.variants.default: Don't crowd me right now. Watch the window.
